verses.1: And after entering the ship, he sailed across the sea and arrived at his own city.
verses.2: And they brought him a rope tied around the chair. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the rope, “Tie me up with this rope, son! Your sins will be forgiven.”
verses.3: And see, some of the officials said to themselves: “He is a liar.”
verses.4: And knowing their thoughts, Jesus said, “Why do you think evil dwell in your hearts?”
verses.5: What is more convenient to say? To say “Your sins are forgiven,” or to say “May you be blessed and travel safely.”
verses.6: And so, so that you know that the son of man has power to bring sin upon the earth—then he says to his wife, “Get up, take your bed and go back to your home.”
verses.7: And he rushed away to his house.
verses.8: Seeing this, the crowd became afraid and praised God for giving humans such power.
verses.9: And as Jesus walked along, he saw a man sitting on the ground. This man was called Matthew. Jesus said to him, “Come with me.” And Matthew got up and followed him.
verses.10: And it happened that he was brought back to life in his house. Many people who were sinners came together with Jesus and His disciples.
verses.11: And when the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, “Why does the teacher eat with sinners and those who are guilty of sins?”
verses.12: And he who heard this said, “It’s not necessary for those who are strong to be doctors; it’s better for those who are weak to be doctors.”
verses.13: But when you learn what it means, you will understand that I desire mercy, not sacrifice. For we were not called to be judges of the righteous, but of the wicked.
verses.14: Then the disciples of John came to him and said, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?”
verses.15: And Jesus said to them, “Can the children of the bridegroom mourn over what he has lost? But when the bridegroom is gone from them, then they will mourn.” And on that day, they will fast.
verses.16: No one should put old clothes on the old shirt. After all, the fabric of the shirt is damaged by wearing it repeatedly, and it becomes difficult to use it as a shirt.
verses.17: They also do not pour fresh wine into old containers. If they do so, then the containers will become damaged, and both the wine and the containers will be ruined. Instead, they pour fresh wine into new containers, so that both can remain intact.
verses.18: As he spoke these things to them, one of the rulers came forward and bowed to him, saying, “My daughter has just died.” But when he came near and touched her hand, she lived again.
verses.19: And Jesus, being excited, followed him; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.20: And behold, a woman who had wept for twelve years came forward and pulled the hem of her garment away from her body.
verses.21: For he said to himself, “If only I can climb onto his shirt, then I’ll be saved.”
verses.22: But Jesus, seeing her, said to her, “Thamar, daughter, your faith has saved you.” And the woman was saved from that hour on.
verses.23: And when Jesus entered the ruler’s house, he saw the musicians and the crowd who were noisy.
verses.24: He said, “Retreat! For the wound has not yet healed; it will still bleed. And he laughed at him.”
verses.25: When the crowd saw this, they rushed forward and grabbed her hand. Then, her hair became disordered.
verses.26: And that rumor spread throughout that entire land.
verses.27: And along with Jesus, there were two blind men who followed him, shouting and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David.”
verses.28: When they entered the house, the blind men came forward to him. Then Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I can do this?” They replied, “Yes, Lord.”
verses.29: Then he took off their eyes, saying, “May this be according to your faith.”
verses.30: And their eyes were opened. And Jesus said to them, “Do not look.”
verses.31: But those who went out spread the news about him throughout all those places.
verses.32: When they came out, they saw that they had brought with them a poor man who was possessed by demons.
verses.33: And after the demon was driven away, the dumb man spoke. The crowd was amazed, saying, “Such a thing has never happened in Israel before.”
verses.34: But the Pharisees said, “He casts out demons through the ruler of demons.”
verses.35: And Jesus went through all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. He also healed all kinds of diseases and weaknesses.
verses.36: Seeing the crowd, they became upset because they were like sheep without a shepherd.
verses.37: Then he says to his disciples: “The work is great, but there are few who can actually carry it out.”
verses.38: Therefore, you should ask the master of the construction to assign workers to carry out his work.
